glyph_origin: According to Shuowen Jiezi an ideogrammic compound (會意): 一 + 㒳. Baxter (1992) observes that, in historical forms, the character is two 丙 joined together; this would make 丙 the phonetic component in a sort of phono-ideogrammic compound (see also Baxter & Sagart (2014)). The character could be linked to the original form of 更, which represents two chariots and a whip.
shuowen: According to Shuowen Jiezi an ideogrammic compound (會意): 一 + 㒳.
senses: [liǎng] two (used in radio communications in aviation and by the military)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 兩; s_page_origin explains the simplified 两.
